peers.name: PFIZER INC
peers.rationale: Large-cap diversified pharma with broad oncology, vaccines, and specialty portfolios overlapping AstraZeneca's therapeutic areas; comparable global scale and R&D-driven model.

peers.name: Merck & Co., Inc.
peers.rationale: Global pharma with strong oncology (Keytruda) and vaccines overlap with AstraZeneca's oncology and biologics focus; similar patent-cliff and pipeline dynamics.

peers.name: BRISTOL MYERS SQUIBB CO
peers.rationale: Oncology and immunology-heavy major pharma comparable to AstraZeneca's core therapeutic focus, with similar biologics and specialty drug economics.

peers.name: ELI LILLY & Co
peers.rationale: Large pharma with overlapping diabetes and immunology franchises, though Lilly's obesity/GLP-1 weighting differs somewhat from AstraZeneca's mix.

peers.name: GSK plc
peers.rationale: UK-based global pharma with overlapping respiratory, vaccines, and oncology businesses; similar geographic mix and ADR-listed comparable multinational structure.

peers.name: Sanofi
peers.rationale: European multinational pharma with overlapping immunology, vaccines, and specialty care segments; comparable global commercial footprint and R&D intensity.

peers.name: NOVARTIS AG
peers.rationale: Swiss-based innovative pharma with overlapping oncology and biologics pipeline, comparable scale and international revenue mix to AstraZeneca.

peers.name: JOHNSON & JOHNSON
peers.rationale: Pharma segment overlaps in oncology and immunology, but J&J's medtech and consumer divisions dilute comparability, so multiple reflects a partial fit.
